benefits: More groves in the same account

paywall.finePrint: Your subscription renews automatically until you cancel. You can cancel any time from subscription management.

paywall.cancelled: Nothing changed. You can continue whenever you like.
paywall.failed: The purchase didn't complete. Try again — if you were charged, Pro will activate automatically.

restore.success: Your purchases were restored. Welcome back to Pro.

success.title: Welcome to Pro
